messages:
eva: Heads up, noticed a weird scatter of tiny pods stuck Pending in ap-southeast1 after the maintenance window. They all show 'nodeAffinity mismatch' + warm-node labels present.
tern: Which affinity? can you paste one pod's spec? usually tiny-pod/anti-affinity flaps after label rollouts.
eva: pasted snippet: `affinity: nodeAffinity: requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution: nodeSelectorTerms: - matchExpressions: - {key: 'warm-node', operator: 'Exists'}`
maria: oh that looks like the warm pool label got reapplied only to some racks during the maintenance, we have a mismatch between warmpool-backed nodes and the new rack labels.
kevin: Could also be that the warmnode pool autoscaler is terminating cold nodes and the scheduler is picky about topologySpreadConstraints -> ends up binpacking tiny pods onto a few nodes and hitting soft taints.
eva: Events show `0/18 nodes are available: 10 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 8 node(s) didn't match node selector`.
tern: @ops-bot can we get current node inventory for the warmpool label in ap-southeast1? I want counts per AZ.
ops-bot: ap-southeast1a: 6 warm-node, ap-southeast1b: 2 warm-node, ap-southeast1c: 0 warm-node (as of 1798642200)
maria: that explains it — we only have warm nodes in a and b. Pods with AZ affinity or zone spread constraints target c and fail, scheduler leaves them pending and some other jobs get evicted to consolidate.
kevin: Rolling a quick mitigation: relax the nodeSelector on the tiny pods (non-critical) to tolerate warm-node absence, or add `tolerations` for soft-taint 'warmpool-preferred'. Which is less risky?
tern: Prefer tolerations + topology preference change. Relaxing nodeSelector may put jobs on GPUs unexpectedly in some cases.
eva: For now I've updated one Deployment to add `tolerations: - key: warmpool-preferred operator: Exists effect: NoSchedule` and a `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` fallback. Scaling looks better for that test group.
maria: Ops: can we schedule a fast replenish of warm nodes in ap-southeast1c? Preferrably spin up 3 small warm nodes to rebalance.
ops-bot: Started scale up job warmpool-ap-southeast1c x3 (ETA ~5m)
kevin: Also logging idea: add a prefilter that surfaces when nodeSelector+taints exclude >30% of nodes in a zone so we can trigger an alert before evictions cascade.
tern: Agreed, adding to scheduler heuristic backlog. For postmortem: capture whether label rollout or ASG cooldown caused the imbalance.
eva: noted — I'll collect pod pending stack traces + scheduler events and drop into the incident doc.
maria: thanks all. once warmpool in c is up, we should revert the temporary tolerations.
kevin: ping when scale completes and we can run a canary eviction to verify no more sticky tiny-pod pending.
ops-bot: warmpool-ap-southeast1c x3 ready (1798642365)
